description.en: Ubigi is a premium eSIM service operated by Transatel, an NTT Group company, with coverage in 200+ destinations. Strong in Europe and North America, it offers reliable networks, in-car connectivity partnerships and pay-as-you-go or subscription plans.
description.zh: Ubigi 由 NTT 集团旗下的 Transatel 运营，覆盖200+目的地，是高端eSIM服务。在欧洲和北美网络表现尤为出色，支持按量付费或订阅制套餐，并与多家车企合作提供车载连接。

en: Strong coverage in Europe and North America
zh: NTT 集团旗下公司运营
为常旅客提供订阅制套餐
欧洲与北美覆盖表现出色
